result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, matching the other purchase-order reports. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes offline, including a new test for your example.

What changed:
- **`DataStore.java`** (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, around line 6514): the sub-select now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other purchase-order queries use. I also updated the javadoc to say cancelled orders are ignored.
- **`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which reproduces your example and expects `Anna:2`, `Bob:1`. The `purchaseOrder` helper gained an overload that takes a status; the existing calls still default to `SENT`.

I didn't run the new test against the old code to watch it fail, so that is unconfirmed. Nothing is committed.
